PROBLEM AND USE CASE

Storage exhaustion interrupts lab work

A laboratory administrator manages research datasets, student workspaces and archives. Current utilization alone does not show how soon each server may run out of room.

Actor

Laboratory administrator reviewing capacity before submissions.

Decision

Which server needs attention, when, and how much capacity should be added?

Precondition: historical usage readings with consistent capacity02 / 08
IMPLEMENTATION

Local collection, browser analysis

LAYERIMPLEMENTATIONRESPONSIBILITY
CollectionPythonRead actual filesystem capacity and usage
HistorySQLite and CSVStore timestamped observations locally
ModelJavaScript OLSFit trends, validate errors, estimate thresholds
InterfaceHTML, CSS and SVGShow forecasts and interactive capacity scenarios

The hosted application processes imported telemetry locally. It does not automatically connect to the laptop or collect data from remote servers.

Dependency-free runtime / offline application included03 / 08
METHOD

A fitted trend estimates the runway

usage = intercept + slope × day
runway = ⌈(threshold − latest usage) / slope⌉

The first 70 of 90 observations train the evaluation model. The last 20 test it. The application then refits all observations and anchors its future trajectory at the latest measured value.

Zero or negative growth has no finite crossing estimate unless the threshold is already reached. The approximate 95% interval assumes independent residuals with constant variance and a continuing linear trend.

Chronological evaluation prevents future observations entering training04 / 08

The baseline holds the last training observation constant. These metrics demonstrate the evaluation process on synthetic trends and do not establish real-world predictive accuracy.

MAE is average absolute error / RMSE penalizes large errors more strongly06 / 08
LIVE WALKTHROUGH

The demonstration

  1. Select each server and inspect its forecast.
  2. Simulate a day and adjust warning thresholds.
  3. Add 250 GB to Atlas in the capacity planner.
  4. Ask the advisor which server reaches 90% first and inspect its tool output.
  5. Inspect a real folder or import measured telemetry.

Open STRATA dashboard

Advisor: deterministic question routing with real local function execution07 / 08
TEAM AND CONCLUSION

Capacity planning with visible evidence

The project combines real usage collection with testable forecasting and reviewable capacity scenarios. Longer measured history and workload-aware models are the next steps.
